form.answered_at_pending: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes: fields, toggles, buttons): note above the buttons after the user answered, before the agent received it. {when} is a date and time from the formatter.
form.too_long: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes: fields, toggles, buttons): note above the buttons when the answers are over the size limit (then an imperative).
form.missing: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes: fields, toggles, buttons): note above the buttons when required questions are unanswered (plural by count; English spells out "One").
form.too_short: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes: fields, toggles, buttons): note above the buttons when a text answer is too short. {field} is the question's label (from the agent) or form.a_text; plural by count.
form.a_text: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes: fields, toggles, buttons): stands in for a text question's label in form.too_short when it has none (noun phrase, subject of the sentence).
form.required: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes: fields, toggles, buttons): small tag after a question's label that must be answered (adjective).
form.no_answer: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes: fields, toggles, buttons): an answered form: shown for a question the user left empty.
form.cancel: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes: fields, toggles, buttons): confirmation bar under a button that asks first: the button that does not send (verb, imperative).
form.ok: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes: fields, toggles, buttons): confirmation bar under a button that asks first: the button that sends (OS-style OK).
form.at_least: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes: fields, toggles, buttons): note under a text field whose answer is too short (plural by count).
form.send_failed: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes): note above the buttons when sending the answers failed on the network.
form.changed: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes): note above the buttons when the agent changed the form while the user answered it; the answers were kept.
form.closed: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes): note on a form the agent closed or that was answered elsewhere.
form.not_taken: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes): note above the buttons when the Host refused the answers as invalid.
form.host_fault: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes): note above the buttons when the Host failed on its side.
form.refused: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes): note above the buttons for any other refusal by the Host.
form.kind: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes): small label at the top of the card naming what it is, and its screen-reader name when it has no title (noun).
form.loading: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes): note while the form loads (ends with an ellipsis).
form.newer: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes): note when the form needs a newer version of this app (verb, imperative). Clarp is the product name, never translated.
form.unreadable: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes): note when the form cannot be read (it is broken).
form.load_failed: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes): note when the form could not be loaded, followed by a Retry button.
form.retry: Form card in the chat (a native form an agent publishes): button that loads the form again (verb, imperative).
app.token_rejected: Full-width notice when the Host refuses this device's saved token. {command} is a terminal command shown as code, never translated ("Run" is imperative).
app.reconnect: Full-width button after the connection to the Host was lost: its accessibility label (verb, imperative).
app.tap_to_reconnect: Full-width button after the connection to the Host was lost (imperative).
conn.label: Small dot showing the connection to the Host: its screen-reader name (noun).
conversation.label: Chat: screen-reader name of the chat area (noun).
conversation.toggle_tools: Chat header buttons: accessibility label of the button that shows every tool call or groups them (verb, imperative).
conversation.tools_all: Chat header buttons: tooltip of the tools button while every tool call shows; where to change it.
conversation.tools_grouped: Chat header buttons: tooltip of the tools button while tool calls are grouped; where to change it.
conversation.explain: Chat header buttons: accessibility label of the button that switches plain-language explanations of tool calls (verb, imperative).
conversation.explain_on: Chat header buttons: tooltip of the explain button while explanations are on; it is a setting of the Host (status, not a command).
conversation.explain_off: Chat header buttons: tooltip of the explain button while explanations are off, so the raw commands show.
conversation.refresh: Chat header buttons: accessibility label of the button that reloads the chat (verb, imperative).
dock.unmute: Dock: accessibility label of the audio button while spoken replies are muted (verb, imperative).
dock.stop_audio: Dock: accessibility label of the audio button while a reply is spoken or ready (verb, imperative).
dock.stop_agent: Dock: accessibility label of the stop button that stops the agent's current turn (verb, imperative).
dock.talk: Dock: accessibility label of the microphone button (verb, imperative: talk to the agent).
panes.resize_sidebar: Desktop: accessibility label of the drag handle between the sidebar and the panes (verb, imperative).
panes.resize: Desktop: accessibility label of the drag handle between two panes; a double click makes them equal (verb, imperative).
panes.split_vertical: Desktop pane header: tooltip of an icon button (verb, imperative; the letter in parentheses is its keyboard key, never translated): split the pane side by side. Title case in English.
panes.split_horizontal: Desktop pane header: tooltip of an icon button (verb, imperative; the letter in parentheses is its keyboard key, never translated): split the pane top and bottom. Title case in English.
panes.zoom: Desktop pane header: tooltip of an icon button (verb, imperative; the letter in parentheses is its keyboard key, never translated): enlarge the pane to fill the window, or back. Title case in English.
panes.close: Desktop pane header: tooltip of an icon button (verb, imperative; the letter in parentheses is its keyboard key, never translated): close the pane. Title case in English.
hidden_run.showing: Chat: line at the top while this visit shows the messages agents sent each other, followed by a Hide button.
hidden_run.hide: Chat: button on the line "Showing messages between agents" that hides them again (verb, imperative).
chat.latest: Chat: floating button that scrolls to the newest message (adjective used as a noun: the latest messages).
turn.not_delivered: Chat: small note under the user's message that did not reach the agent; pressing the up arrow key sends it again (keep ↑ and the middle dot).
turn.queued: Chat: small note under the user's message waiting for the agent's current turn (past participle).
voice.loading: Voice picker dialog (choose the voice an agent speaks with): list of voices while it loads (ends with an ellipsis).
voice.load_failed: Voice picker dialog (choose the voice an agent speaks with): list of voices when loading failed.
voice.rejected: Voice picker dialog (choose the voice an agent speaks with): toast when the Host refused the chosen voice. {error} is the Host's error code or voice.rejected_default (lowercase, technical).
voice.rejected_default: Voice picker dialog (choose the voice an agent speaks with): the reason in voice.rejected when the Host gave none (lowercase, past participle).
voice.updated: Voice picker dialog (choose the voice an agent speaks with): toast after a voice was chosen. {name} is the agent's name, never translated.
voice.title: Voice picker dialog (choose the voice an agent speaks with): dialog title. {name} is the agent's name, never translated (possessive).
voice.used_by: Voice picker dialog (choose the voice an agent speaks with): after a voice's name when another agent has it. {name} is that agent's name, never translated (lowercase, after a middle dot).
voice.current: Voice picker dialog (choose the voice an agent speaks with): after a voice's name when this agent has it now (lowercase adjective, after a middle dot).
voice.use: Voice picker dialog (choose the voice an agent speaks with): small button that gives this voice to the agent (verb, imperative; lowercase in English).
voice.done: Voice picker dialog (choose the voice an agent speaks with): button that closes the dialog (OS-style Done).
host_badge.on: Chat list and chat header: tooltip of the small Host label on a chat, naming the Host computer it runs on. {host} is the Host's name, never translated.
